thread:
elaine: Heads up — ran into an allowlist/role-binding bypass on a Dedicated tenant after the recent RBAC role rename. Guest users were able to see admin controls. Repro steps and logs below. :eyes:

raj: steps?

elaine: repro:
1) create tenant `ondedicated-foo`
2) invite user guest@acme via SCIM
3) login as guest -> visited /admin/ui -> returned 200 and admin buttons visible
logs show: `subject=sub:guest principal=svcacct:platform-proxy -> bound role=tenant-admin`

miguel: can you paste the RoleBinding YAML?

elaine: snippet:
```
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: proxy-tenant-admin
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: platform-proxy
roleRef:
  name: tenant-admin
condition: tenant==*
```

sara: That `tenant==*` condition is suspicious. I thought the refactor replaced wildcards with explicit tenant checks (PR eng-security#412).

security-bot: Alert: privilege-escalation-detection triggered for tenant 'ondedicated-foo' at 2025-11-12T08:12:34Z

raj: ok — two tracks: stop the immediate blast radius, and triage scope. Can we see audit logs for platform-proxy usage (token/kms ops)?

elaine: pasted relevant audit lines:
```
2025-11-12T08:11:58Z svc=platform-proxy action=assume role=tenant-admin tenant=ondedicated-foo token_id=tok_3Xy.. result=allowed
2025-11-12T08:12:01Z svc=platform-proxy action=get /admin/ui user=guest@acme token_id=tok_3Xy.. result=200
```

dmitri: KMS side — we rotated the dedicated signing key in 2025-10 but these logs show token id usage not key unwraps. Still, we should invalidate the token and check if any key material was requested.

ops-oncall: I'm revoking the platform-proxy token in prod-dedicated region-1 now. Will also add a temporary firewall rule on the control-plane ingress to restrict serviceedge IP range.

miguel: proposed hotfix: patch RoleBinding to remove wildcard and scope by tenant + source. Eg:
```
condition:
  tenant: ondedicated-foo
  source: serviceedge
```
and add a validation rule in the RBAC controller to reject `tenant==*` for service accounts. I can ship a patch and a canary deploy.

raj: triage owners: miguel = hotfix, elaine = audit/backfill to SIEM, dmitri = KMS/key usage review. ETA 2h for hotfix and token revocation.

sara: after hotfix we need to run RBAC linter across repos, add a CI smoke test that creates a dummy tenant and verifies `/admin` is 403 for guest, and add an eval that simulates platform-proxy traffic. Also add docs about disallowing wildcard tenant bindings.

elaine: ack. I'll open follow-up tickets and flag any affected customers. Also will search last 30 days of audit logs for `svc=platform-proxy` usage and push results to the incident.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-2248, severity=medium, owners=[miguel,elaine,dmitri]

elaine: @ops-oncall please confirm token revocation when done. :lock:

ops-oncall: done — token tok_3Xy.. revoked, firewall rule applied. Monitoring for anomalous admin API calls; will report in 15m.

miguel: rolling patch to rbac-controller branch `fix/scope-proxy-bindings`, will deploy to canary in 10m.

raj: good. once canary green, promote. also add post-deploy audit check that queries SIEM for any remaining `tenant==*` RoleBindings.

elaine: thanks all. I'll collect timeline + logs for INC-2025-2248 and loop in infra compliance for any notice requirements.

sara: nice quick containment. Follow-up: add automated test to detect wildcard conditions and a periodic RBAC snapshot diff for Dedicated/Private control planes.

security-bot: Reminder: add runbook steps to the incident (rbac_escalation_runbook v1).

elaine: will do.
